DATA & MODEL

Know what the numbers mean.

Replay

Bundled synthetic telemetry on a schematic circuit. No team data is included.

Energy & outcomes

Battery energy, branch gaps/positions and outcomes are simulated with explicit demo constraints. Historical telemetry is shown separately as reference evidence.

Frozen model

Seed 42, best validation checkpoint epoch 28. The experimental boundary position-swap score is advisory-only and does not select the action.

Historical replay

The bundled fixture is an approved development-validation race segment. Car and position values are real FastF1 samples selected backward-only within one second; no outcome labels or protected holdouts are bundled.

Load historical telemetry

Import an OpenF1 car_data JSON array or a combined file made by the included fetch script. Speed, throttle, brake and gear become recorded values. Rival gaps and energy remain simulated.

Model limits and sources

Energy follows E_next = E_start - E_deploy + E_recovered at the battery-side boundary. Deployment and recovery are power/capacity constrained; infeasible requests are logged.

The objective is a weighted utility. Position value per MJ is a reporting metric, not a claimed new scientific law. Limits are demo constraints, not FIA compliance claims.

OpenF1 documentation / FastF1 documentation

Replay data must have a valid timestamp and finite speed. Files stay on this device in offline mode. Historical playback is not a live team connection.

90-SECOND DEMO

Let the judge make the first call.

  1. 00-20 SEC

    Set the scene.

    Show the race state and identify which data is simulated. Ask whether to attack, hold, harvest, or defend.

  2. 20-45 SEC

    Commit to a decision.

    Select their first move and compare futures. Show the full action sequences and identical random seed.

  3. 45-70 SEC

    Test the explanation.

    Open Strategy lab. Change energy or rear gap and watch the recommended decision change.

  4. 70-90 SEC

    Show the evidence.

    Run validation. Show wins, ties, losses and model constraints. Export a decision so it can be reproduced.
